notes: Yearly Market — trade goods only (not gear slots). Marks refresh each cage year. Bartering softens buy price and lifts sell payout. No tobacco/drugs/alcohol. Icons optional later: assets/market/<id>.png

act.note: Opening Market from Belongings/Adventure is free once listings exist for the year. Visit market/stall locations still give the old crowd-work coin + bartering XP.

seed.note: Derive a mulberry32 seed from save RNG seed + Math.floor(cage age) + current region id so listings/marks are stable for the year and differ by realm.

ui.pctNote: Show markPct on each listing (year mark before personal Bartering). Show effective buy/sell gold after Bartering under the price.

formulas.sellMarkPct: If this good is listed this year in the current realm, use that listing's markPct; else 0 (fair).

heralds.text: Market Row chalk reads soft on Hearthfold Honey Jars — wasps louder than brokers this winter.
Pond Reed Baskets price fair by the willow shade; anglers trade gossip louder than coin.
Vale Loom Wool climbs dear after a wet shear; Cottage Lane fences wear fewer colors.
Mirrorglass Stalls claim a glut of bright trays — Lantern Quay musicians quarrel over reflections.
Imported dyes sit firm on the quay boards; Ledger Hall clerks sharpen their quills.
Envoy of Scales watches a dear mark on coast metal; oaths cost more than pans today.
Foragers’ Camp lists soft marks on reed reagents; Standing Stone Ring stays quiet about why.
Reedpath packs carry fair-priced staves; Ashen Gate porters want tea, not stories.
Black Mirror Pond finds keep a dear curio price — Wayshrine ribbons look thin.
Scribe Stalls drown in ink glut; Archive Steps smell like wet paper and ambition.
Collegium runners say quill-kits are firm; Crest Terrace bets on who fails the first exam.
Fair ward-chalk on the dueling lawn board — tutors pretend not to notice.
Forge Plaza rings firm ore marks; Watch Fort apprentices count sparks, not sleep.
Dear ember-sand jars near Sparkfield; Hero Statue gets fresh soot polish anyway.
Ash Park cooks cheer a provision glut; Cinderhorn Hall boards rewrite supper tallies.
Year-turn stalls reshuffle under new chalk. Bartering tongues wake before the sun does.
